name: News Credibility AI
description: Train, explain, monitor, and review news credibility classifiers with explicit human evidence workflows.
summary: A model operations and review workspace for labeled news datasets. Training runs, champion selection, explanations, and human-entered evidence are kept distinct; predictions do not establish factual truth.
architecture: Next.js calls FastAPI services for dataset ingestion, training, experiments, inference, monitoring, and human review. PostgreSQL stores records while vectorizers and trained models remain filesystem artifacts. Predictions describe learned patterns; reviewer-entered evidence is not automatically fact-checked.

capabilities.name: Classifier experiments
capabilities.description: Train TF-IDF baselines, compare stored metrics, and select a champion explicitly.

capabilities.name: Explained predictions
capabilities.description: Analyze articles, save prediction history, and inspect model feature attribution.

capabilities.name: Review and monitoring
capabilities.description: Record human labels, manual claims and evidence, and inspect drift diagnostics.

stack.usage: Pages expose experiments, article analysis, evidence review, and monitoring.
Typed requests and responses describe model runs and review records.
Bounded endpoints manage datasets, training, champion selection, and human review.
Python services manage artifacts, model lifecycle, and monitoring profiles.
TF-IDF feeds Logistic Regression and calibrated Linear SVM pipelines.
Lazy-loaded DistilBERT training and inference provide an alternative to classical models.
PyTorch runs the optional DistilBERT training and inference path.
SHAP outputs explain model behavior rather than proving factual claims.
Relational storage retains articles, experiments, evidence, reviews, and monitoring profiles.
Docker Compose configures application and database services.

architectureConnections.description: Training services build and persist TF-IDF classifier pipelines.
DistilBERT executes through the PyTorch model runtime.
Review and experiment endpoints persist structured records.

evidence.notes: Reviewed repository README and available dependency manifests. Capabilities describe implemented workflows; roadmap items are excluded.
